Pro Cycle Thursday Night Social Ride

Fairhope, AL · Downtown · Road

No-drop

Pro Cycle Thursday Night Social Ride is a road group ride in Fairhope, AL. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Pro Cycle Fairhope. About 20 miles, 17–18 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 17–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @procyclefairhope the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Pro Cycle Thursday Night Social Ride group ride

The easier of the shop's two weeknight rides on the Eastern Shore of Mobile Bay. Twenty miles at 17 to 18 mph, no-drop. Tuesday is the hammerfest; Saturday morning is a 28-mile year-round ride.
